items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Dave Peyton at the Regal Theater.

ctx.x: of his columns, he puts down the guys who were playing in cabarets, a lot of the New Orleans musicians. There seemed to be some bad feeling between the established Chicago musicians and the guys coming up from New Orleans. Were you aware of any of that?
No, I wasn't. I worked with Dave Peyton at the Regal Theater.
